g.text: Language differs between held and flipped answers
Descriptive associations from lexical features, not causal explanations
Higher confidence in the wrong argument
Manually curated lexicons; case-insensitive substring matching.
Response markers partly describe the outcome; they do not establish why it happened.
Who Flips? arXiv:2606.16011v2 | §5.4; Figure 2; Appendix B
